sentences.text:
Author: Raj Beer Singh
Bench: Raj Beer Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 77
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 52216 of 2022
Applicant :- Munna @ Waseem Ahmad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others Counsel for Applicant :- Shams Tabrez Ali Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Raj Kumar Kesari Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for the first informant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The present bail application has been filed by the applicant in Session Case No. 750 of 2022, Case Crime No. 101 of 2022, under Sections 376-AB, 354-Kha IPC and Section 5m/6 Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, P.S. Jaitpura, District Varanasi, with the prayer to enlarge him on bail.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It has been argued by the learned counsel for the applicant/accused that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.

It was submitted that in fact informant is working as a broker and applicant was working there as labourer and dispute has taken place on the rate of labour work and applicant has been falsely implicated in this case due that reason.

It was pointed Munna @ Waseem Ahmad vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160576121/
1 out that in G.D. entry, recorded regarding arrest of applicant, it has been mentioned that there was no fresh injury on the body of applicant, whereas, as per medical examination report of applicant,
one injury has been shown on his person.

entities.text: Munna @ Waseem Ahmad vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel has given much thrust to the argument that victim girl has not sustained any injury at her body.
No injury was shown at her private parts and hymen was shown intact.
As per medical examination report, there was no evidence of sexual assault at the time of medical examination.
Referring to these facts, it was submitted that the allegations made by the informant and the victim girl are thoroughly false.
Further, there are contradictions in the statements of informant and victim girl.

Learned counsel has placed reliance upon the case of Parmanand vs. State of U.P. & 3 Ors (Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 13814 of 2022 and it is submitted that on similar facts, bail was granted in that matter.

entities.text: Parmanand vs. State of U.P. & 3 Ors (Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 13814 of 2022
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Lastly, it was submitted that the applicant is languishing in jail since 06.06.2022, having no criminal history, and that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and cooperate in the trial.

Learned A.G.A. and learned counsel for the first informant have opposed the prayer of bail and argued that victim is a 8 years old minor girl and she has made clear allegations of molestation against the applicant.

Referring to provisions of Section 375 IPC as well as the provisions of POCSO Act, it was pointed out that in view of allegations made by victim girl, it is not necessary that she must have sustained any injury at her private parts.
It is also submitted that no person would implicate his eight years girl due to some minor dispute, as alleged on behalf of applicant.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, gravity of offence and all attending facts and circumstances of case, the applicant is not entitled to be enlarged on bail.
Hence, the bail application of applicant Munna @ Waseem Ahmad is hereby rejected.

Order Date :- 23.3.2023 A. Tripathi  Munna @ Waseem Ahmad vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160576121/
